label: K01
title: Counterexample receipt
proposal: For each accepted claim, attach a rival mechanism and the observation that would refute it.
feasible_observation: Review six fictional accepted claims including misleading transport successes.
falsifier: Review time rises with no fewer false acceptances.

label: K02
title: Evidence beside each claim
proposal: Place the evidence location beside the claim to reduce lookup time.
feasible_observation: Compare lookup seconds and wrong citations on matched fictional reports.
falsifier: Time savings disappear with matched length or errors increase.

label: K03
title: Diverse failure replay
proposal: Select different failure mechanisms, reconcile opposing explanations, and link each replay to task outcomes.
feasible_observation: Compare a six-case diverse set with six near-duplicate cases.
rival_explanation: Difficulty rather than diversity causes the difference.
falsifier: No additional failure class detected after matching difficulty.

label: K04
title: Group repeated failures
proposal: Group duplicate error signatures while retaining unique task counts.
feasible_observation: Seed repeated events and distinct errors with similar labels.
falsifier: A distinct failure is suppressed or denominator changes.

label: K05
title: Checklist before acceptance
proposal: Use a short acceptance checklist so omissions are visible.
feasible_observation: Inspect ten fictional outputs with planted missing fields.
rival_explanation: More attention rather than the checklist explains errors found.
falsifier: No fewer missed fields at equal review time.

label: K06
title: Coverage-aware handoff
proposal: Carry missing-evidence flags through a novel division of work, then reconcile conflicting task states.
feasible_observation: Drop one outcome from a paired-worker handoff.
rival_explanation: A basic required-field check performs equally well.
falsifier: Unknown outcome is silently accepted or no benefit versus simple validation.

label: K07
title: Sample completed work
proposal: Audit a fixed sample of apparently accepted outcomes.
feasible_observation: Plant a known distribution of failures and report missed failures.
rival_explanation: Observed success reflects a benign sample.
falsifier: An unreviewed critical failure escapes; no all-safe inference permitted.

label: K08
title: Stop-rule contradiction register
proposal: Combine uncommon stop scenarios, explicit contradictory claims, and observable acceptance events.
feasible_observation: Seed stale evidence, duplicate attempts, and reviewer rejection.
rival_explanation: The register restates an existing contract.
falsifier: No decision changes beyond the existing outcome contract.

label: K09
title: Review only changed material
proposal: Display the delta and retain a path to the full source.
feasible_observation: Plant a context-dependent error outside the visible delta.
falsifier: Context errors rise despite lower review time.

label: K10
title: Disagreement-triggered evidence audit
proposal: Combine diverse failure hypotheses, contradiction mapping, and task-level evidence joins.
feasible_observation: Compare targeted checks against O1 on the same planted errors.
rival_explanation: Extra reviewer time, not targeting, explains improvement.
falsifier: No extra critical errors found at equal total time.

label: K11
title: Stop ambiguous cases
proposal: Route missing evidence to a reviewer instead of guessing.
feasible_observation: Use a fixed packet with ambiguous and clear cases.
rival_explanation: Increased abstention simply transfers all work.
falsifier: Total review time rises without fewer escaped errors.

label: K12
title: Proxy challenge panel
proposal: For each speed metric, pair an alternate mechanism with an outcome-level countercheck.
feasible_observation: Construct lower-token cases with higher reviewer effort.
falsifier: Recommendation reverses under plausible rates without a stated boundary.
